Historical and traditional constructions have employed clay tiles, marble, thatch, wood shingles, slate, turf roofs, reeds, mud, lime/mortar, and corrugated iron sheeting [d7,d8]. These perspectives are complementary rather than contradictory, as they address different eras and building traditions.
